name: How long does it take to paint interior walls in a house?
description: Most simple wall-only projects take a few days, but larger homes or repairs can stretch the schedule.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint interior walls in a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline depends on how many rooms are being painted, how much patching is needed, and whether the project includes ceilings or trim. Many straightforward wall-only projects finish in a few days, but larger homes take longer.
